## The increase multiplier {#fm1-increase-factor .fm-slide }

::: {.takeaway}
$$\text{New amount}=\text{Original}\times\left(1+\frac{p}{100}\right)$$
:::

An 8% increase leaves **108% of the original**.

$$100\%+8\%=108\%\qquad\longleftrightarrow\qquad1.08$$

::: notes
Booklet §1.1, p. 2. Connect this explicitly to Example 1.1. The multiplier contains both the original amount and the increase. Ask students to give the multiplier for a 12% increase (1.12).
:::
